description: Privilege tiers for the approval gate (hooks/tier_gate.py). First matching tier wins. Tool names are Claude Code's mcp__<server>__<tool>; server labels come from the mcp config (fs, git, fetch, github). Tier 0 never prompts, tier 1 prompts once per call, tier 2 is refused outright: change the policy, not the prompt, if you really need it.
default_reason: tool not classified in policies/tiers.json; a human decides

tiers.name: tier 0: read-only, stays on this laptop
tiers.reason: read-only tool, auto-approved; the boundary still confines paths

tiers.name: tier 1: reversible local write, or network read
tiers.reason: writes inside the workspace or local git history, or reaches the network; one approval per call

tiers.name: tier 2: irreversible, or leaves the laptop
tiers.reason: refused by policy: destructive or external write. If this is really wanted, a human runs it outside the agent
